material_sources.inspection_evidence: Downloaded 29-page arXiv PDF via proxy and extracted full text. Theorem 3.2 bounds R0(u,v) by group-specific Ri0=R0(1,v) (single-group system spread over v patches), not isolated-patch values, in a Lagrangian residence-time (M/P mobility matrices) SEIRS framework. Proof uses Frobenius column-sum inequality on Z matrix under M P^T irreducibility. Full-text search finds no joint scalar m, no separate E/I movement generators, no opposite-direction churn, and none of beta=(1,2), sigma=(3,1), H(1) entries, 106/2025, or 0.26995.

material_sources.inspection_evidence: Downloaded arXiv SEIR metapopulation PDF via proxy and extracted full text. Section 3.2.1 gives R0=max R(i)0 only at M=0 (block-diagonal, no movement); Theorem 3.2 proves min<=R0<=max only under full homogeneity (beta_i=beta, gamma_i=gamma, equal removal sums) AND ME=MI=0, via column-sum/Perron-Frobenius argument. The submitted witness has heterogeneous epi parameters and nonzero opposite E/I movement at m=1, outside those hypotheses; body contains no E 2->1 / I 1->2 churn pair or matching numeric witness.
